modules.purpose: The facts the product moves, with no I/O.
The traits the product reaches the outside through, and their fakes for tests.
<job>: one use case, written against ports only.
<capability>, shared, with its own error type and no product types; it depends on another lib crate only by an edge listed in ci/check-lib-imports.sh's allowed line.
Config, the only reader of the environment, and the adapters wired once, one file per adapter group.
The verb registry: one file per command, each turning its typed answer into a reply.
The one writer: JSON on stdout, text on stderr, every failure with its exit code.
The crash record a panic leaves as a JSON file, its hook installed first in main; stderr keeps the default panic message.

ignored.why: Build, packaging and proof scripts, not product code.
CI workflow and Dependabot settings, not product code.
The shared homes list, not product code.
Crate roots: only mod and pub use lines; each module they expose is mapped above.
Integration tests and their fixtures; each tests the module its name says.
